title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the net acceleration at D as a = g + (√2 kQq)/(2md²).

title: Acceleration direction
description: Essential: States the direction of acceleration at D is vertically downward (from M to N).

title: Potential at C
description: Essential: Correctly derives the electric potential at point C as φ_C = (mv² - 2mgd)/(2q).

title: Kinetic energy at F
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the final kinetic energy as E_k = mgd + mv² - (kQq/d)(1 - √2/2).

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem correctly between relevant points (e.g., C-D, D-E, or E-F).

title: Force resolution at D
description: Important: Correctly resolves the electrostatic forces from A and B into vertical components at point D.

title: Potential symmetry use
description: Important: Recognizes and uses the electric potential symmetry (e.g., φ_D = 0) for the dipole configuration.

title: Sign error in potential
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for the potential due to a negative charge (e.g., for point B or after A's removal).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout the derivation or explicitly states them in the final answer.

title: Geometry for distances
description: Optional: Correctly identifies and uses geometric distances (e.g., √2 d for diagonal distances).
